put.description:
Per-plan overrides; apply to every tenant on the plan without its own override. trial_days applies to tenants created
afterwards (existing trials keep their end date).
Per-tenant overrides. Changing trial_days moves this tenant's trial end to trial start + trial_days.

post.description:
Credit (topup = money received, with receipt and tier bonus; promo = free credit) or correct (adjustment, +/-) a wallet.
Idempotency-Key is required: a retry returns the same result (200, replayed) instead of crediting twice.
Billing state `suspended`: new bills are refused (402 billing_suspended) until resumed; everything else keeps working.
Append-only; idempotent per (reporting service, external_id). Service clients only.
Second step of sign-in. Accepts a TOTP code or a one-time recovery code.

Fresh second factor for a sensitive action (docs/STEP_UP.md). Returns a short-lived grant bound to this staff member
and this session; send it as header X-Step-Up-Token on the protected request. Same per-staff throttle as sign-in codes.

Flagged (TOPUP_ONLINE_ENABLED): 503 topup_unavailable while off. On: a pending Razorpay order row; `checkout` stays null
until payments-service creates the provider order (docs/PAYG_BILLING.md "Razorpay seam").
Metering from pos-service: idempotent per (bill_id, event). Always accepted (a bill is never refused here).

RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_ENABLED=false: 404. On: X-Razorpay-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, raw body).
`payment.captured` / `order.paid` with notes.topup_order_id credit that order once (unique payment id).

put.description: Non-secret, platform-wide settings (feature switches, maintenance banner, limits). Secrets do not belong here.

get.description:
Entitlement check for other services. Auth: Bearer staff token or X-Service-Key with `entitlements.read`.
`ref` is a tenant id or slug. Unknown tenant -> 404 (callers must fail closed).

post.description:
Single intake for self-signup (anonymous, per-IP rate limited) and marketing-service (X-Service-Key with the
`onboarding.submit` scope) and staff (Bearer with onboarding.manage). Same state machine for all.

get.description:
Staff (onboarding.read) or a service with scope `onboarding.read`. Services only see marketing-sourced
applications (their own intake channel); anything else is a 404 and the submitter IP is never exposed to them.

post.description: Runs provisioning now (from `approved`) or, from `failed`, a manual retry. See docs/PROVISIONING.md.

get.description:
Poll target for marketing-service (scope onboarding.read; only marketing-sourced applications) and staff. A small,
stable view: no payload, no submitter IP, no error text from the callee (only a short code).

post.description: Staff: ask pos-service whether the owner has set a password yet (owner_invited -> live).
Staff: email the owner a fresh set-password link (state owner_invited only).
Staff: retry a failed provisioning immediately (ignores the backoff and the attempt budget).
Staff or a scheduler holding the service scope `onboarding.provision`: one sweep (queued, due retries, stale, invite -> live).

put.description:
Edit name/description/price and the whole feature+limit set in one versioned, audited step. Tenants already on
the plan get the new features immediately (diff recorded per tenant); the new price applies to invoices created from now on.
Replaces the plan's feature set. Entitlements of every tenant on this plan change, and each diff is recorded.

post.description: Retired plans cannot be newly assigned; tenants already on one keep it (grandfathered). Plans are never deleted.

Lost device and lost recovery codes: a super_admin clears the factor and ends the person's sessions. A mandatory
role must enrol again at the next sign-in.

A time-boxed, audited authorization for ONE support engineer to look at ONE tenant. This service only records it and
can mint a short-lived token for pos-service to verify; it never fetches or proxies tenant operational data.

get.description: For pos-service: is this grant still valid right now (catches revocation before token expiry)?

patch.description:
display_name and/or business_types (the full new selection). A change re-derives the business-type entitlement defaults
here (diff recorded in entitlement_history, trigger `business_types_changed`). Adding a type never removes data; removing
one only changes defaults. For a provisioned tenant the selection is then pushed to pos-service
(PUT /internal/provision/tenants/{id}/business-types, idempotent; pos-service hides / shows tables, dine-in, reservations).
The response's `pos_sync` says how that went: synced | not_provisioned | not_found | failed:<code>. A failed push never
fails the PATCH: send the same business_types again to retry (docs/PROVISIONING.md).

get.description:
Contract for pos-service (docs/entitlements-contract.md). Auth: X-Service-Key with scope `entitlements:read`
(or staff with entitlements.read). Unknown tenant -> 404; callers must fail closed.
